answers.question: How do I view the event history on this panel?
answers.text:
The local model’s wording did not pass source checking. Here are relevant manual extracts; I have not established a complete answer.
1. “For this fictional panel, the read-only event history is available from the front controls. 1. Press VIEW on the panel front. 2. Select EVENT HISTORY from the displayed menu. 3. Use the UP and DOWN buttons to browse the stored events. 4. Press BACK to leave event history. The EVENT HISTORY menu is inside VIEW. Step two selects EVENT HISTORY after VIEW has already been opened. Viewing the log does not clear its entries or reset a fault.”
2. “This fictional fire alarm control panel exists only for browser verification. The model names, buttons and behaviour below do not describe real equipment. Confirm the equipment label before applying any actual manufacturer procedure. This fixture supports read-only questions about event history. It does not provide installer access codes, disablement procedures, electrical tests or authority to impair a fire alarm system.”

Applies to the recorded equipment: Test Bench FINDR-QA-100 not established. These are shortened excerpts; check the cited page for surrounding conditions and the full procedure. Check the cited pages, or add the relevant manual, diagram or configuration detail.
